title: blessed/release-surfaces/v1
description: Repo-local release-surface declaration (releases.surfaces@1). The FIRST executable canonical definition of this proposal-status contract. Structural and per-kind rules live here; relational rules (document-wide uniqueness, cross-repo authority, URL containment, kind x publisher x transport compatibility, case-insensitive repo identity) are enforced by the semantic validator in scripts/release/validate-surfaces.sh, because a JSON Schema cannot express them.

product.description: Canonical root identity. `project` is NOT an accepted alias; a document carrying it (or both) is rejected by additionalProperties.

token.description: Canonical lowercase token. No blanks, no coercion, no defaults.

ownerName.description: GitHub OWNER segment, defined separately from the repository segment. Alphanumeric with single internal hyphens; no dot, underscore, leading or trailing hyphen, or consecutive hyphens; 1-39 characters TOTAL. The leading lookahead caps the whole token — counting hyphen-joined groups instead would let a 46-character owner through. Syntax validation only; this is not proof the owner exists.

repoName.description: GitHub REPOSITORY segment: ASCII letters, digits, dot, hyphen, underscore, 1-100 characters, but never '.' or '..'. Leading-dot names such as .github are valid. Syntax validation only.

repo.description: GitHub owner/repository. Composes $defs.ownerName and $defs.repoName into one pattern, since a JSON Schema pattern applies to the whole string. Identity comparison is case-insensitive and is done by the semantic validator. Syntax only — never a claim that the repository exists.

relPath.description: Relative POSIX path. Each segment must begin with an alphanumeric or underscore, which rejects in one production: absolute paths, '.', '..', empty segments, and dotfiles such as .git. The character class also rejects backslashes, globs, templates/placeholders, and percent-encoding.

relDirPrefix.description: Relative POSIX directory prefix with a REQUIRED trailing slash. Same segment rules as relPath. This replaces the undefined `releases/<tag>/*` template language: the receiver appends the validated tag and artifact basename as single safe segments.

publicBaseUrl.description: Single CANONICAL public origin+path, so equivalent authorities cannot have different spellings. https only; host must be lowercase; EXPLICIT PORTS ARE FORBIDDEN — partial normalization is a trap, since :443, :0443, and an omitted port all denote the same authority; no userinfo, query, fragment, percent-encoding, or dot segments; normalized; trailing slash REQUIRED. There is no separate public_prefix: one field carries this authority.

publisherModel.description: CLOSED. Only surface-pull has prose-normative backing in releases.surfaces@1. producer-push-pr, state-repo-ci-through-api, and reviewed-pull-request are deliberately excluded from executable v1.

promotionTransport.description: CLOSED. Candidate-ready SIGNAL only, never publication authority. Both literals are prose-normative (releases.surfaces@1 Vocabulary; releases.promotion-handshake@1 Event contract).

promotionOutput.description: One deterministic generator output. `role` names a renderer TYPE, not a unique instance, so `id` supplies instance identity and multiple channels may share a renderer.

renderer_config.description: Path to a checked-in blessed/downloads-index-renderer-config/v1 file, read from the exact trusted receiver base SHA. Legal ONLY for role downloads-index, which cannot be rendered from the signed candidate alone: labels, primary choices, os/arch presentation, kind naming, site-facing MIME, and artifact selection have no candidate authority. Optional in the SCHEMA so every 0.2.3-valid declaration stays valid, but generator admission REJECTS a downloads-index that omits it.

allOf.description: renderer_config is presentation policy for the index only; a pointer renderer has no presentation to declare.

producer_repos.description: Nonempty and unique. A self-produced surface declares [owner_repo].

consumer_contract.description: OPAQUE open vocabulary with closed syntax. Neither schema nor generator may use an unknown value to authorize, route, or select behavior.

access_model.description: OPAQUE open vocabulary with closed syntax. Same non-authorization rule as consumer_contract.

package_formats.description: package-repository-surface only (releases.package-repositories@1): the native repository formats this surface serves. Closed set.

allOf.description: package-repository-surface (releases.package-repositories@1) carries public_base_url and package_formats, and NOT the browser-download fields: APT/DNF is not a download renderer.
Every other kind is universal-contract only in v1: declaration-shape support, not operational support.
